set.body: Field observation from the Haxby exemplar (exemplars/haxby2001/05-crossnobis-uncertainty.R): the analytic covariance path evaluates one frame node per call, costs ~7 s/node at q=8 on ~50-voxel spheres, and both per-node time and process RSS grow as a sequential loop proceeds. The certified scale benchmark (benchmarks/run-sampling-covariance-scale.R) measured a single node, so map-level cost was never gated. Violates the vision requirement that the principled path be practical at brain scale. Suspected: per-call recomputation of plan/fit-invariant work (residual factorization, contrasts, validation) plus an accumulation leak. Fix shapes: precompute-once object shared across nodes, vectorized at=, leak repair. Optimization must preserve the estimand and plan identity per effect-form-v1 §9; only receipt identity may change.
set.title: rdm_sampling_covariance() is ~7 s/node, single-node-only, and appears to leak across calls: a 577-node VT sweep takes >1 h while rdm() takes 0.48 s
